hypothesis.statement: A reviewed reconstruction selection can still lose identity lineage or be mistaken for production topology when it is manually prepared for MetaHuman Identity.
hypothesis.action: Convert the P27 receipt into an immutable UE 5.6 work order that seals source mesh, postprocess state, shortlist, identity authority and Go profile checksums, while forcing a separate neutral head-neck-eyes export and MetaHuman topology after conform.
hypothesis.expectedResult: Unreal Editor evidence can only be collected from a MetaHuman candidate whose input handoff traces back to the reviewed temporary shape estimate.

requiredPreparation: isolate neutral head, neck and eyes
remove hair, clothing, accessories and hidden helpers
normalize to cm, +Z up and +X forward
apply transforms and validate nonzero bounds
export an immutable OBJ or FBX working copy
decision: Preserve the v79 head-only handoff as fallback evidence, but require a P28 selection-derived handoff for any future candidate binding and Editor evidence.
